# `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` — Issue Forms

Structured GitHub issue forms — the tracker does not accept blank issues
(`config.yml`). Pick the right form so the maintainer can act without a round-trip.

| Form | When to use |
|---|---|
| [`bug_report.yml`](bug_report.yml) | something does not run or a number does not reproduce; includes area, platform, commit and full-output fields |
| [`feature_request.yml`](feature_request.yml) | new verification port, new physics run, tooling or docs; requires the IPL-RP-1.0 acknowledgment |
| [`verification_request.yml`](verification_request.yml) | you are trying to verify a claim and need help — the preferred form for reproduction questions |

For open mathematical discussion (not tied to a defect), use
[Discussions](https://github.com/wild8highlander/navier-stokes-b/discussions) instead.
Security-related reports must not go through public issues — see
[`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md).
